summary: Corteva and EIDP filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a September 9, 2026 settlement among Corteva, Chemours, DuPont, the State of North Carolina, ten local subdivisions, and the Lower Cape Fear Water and Sewer Authority resolving statewide PFAS and Fayetteville Works claims plus NC Consent Order obligations. The companies will collectively pay $455 million over 15 years; Corteva's share is about $66 million. Corteva and DuPont guarantee Chemours' share 29%/71% and must establish a reserve funded by line of credit, letter of credit, or surety bond capped at $135 million. Watch guarantee calls and reserve funding costs.
